# Azure ARM/Bicep Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > Azure

## Overview

Creates Azure infrastructure as code with ARM templates and Bicep including modules, parameters, and deployment management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [azure-arm-template-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
azure-arm-template-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@azure-arm-template-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Create Bicep templates with modular design
- Implement parameter files for environments
- Use Bicep modules for code reuse
- Run what-if analysis before deployment

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Bicep**: Bicep language and module patterns
- **ARM Templates**: Template structure and functions
- **What-If**: Pre-deployment impact analysis
